verse.unicode: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤੁਮ ਜਗਿ ਆਏ ਸੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: jis jal nidh kaaran tum jag aae so a(n)mrit gur paahee jeeau ||

en.bdb: The treasure of the Name, for which you have come into the world - that Ambrosial Nectar is with the Guru.

verse.unicode: ਛੋਡਹੁ ਵੇਸੁ ਭੇਖ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਇਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: chhoddahu ves bhekh chaturaiee dhubidhaa ih fal naahee jeeau ||1||

en.bdb: Renounce costumes, disguises and clever tricks; this fruit is not obtained by duplicity. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੁ ਮਤੁ ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: man re thir rahu mat kat jaahee jeeau ||

en.bdb: O my mind, remain steady, and do not wander away.

verse.unicode: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂਢਤ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਘਟ ਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: baahar ddooddat bahut dhukh paaveh ghar a(n)mrit ghaT maahee jeeau || rahaau ||

en.bdb: By searching around on the outside, you shall only suffer great pain; the Ambrosial Nectar is found within the home of your own being. ||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਪਛੁਤਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: avagun chhodd gunaa kau dhaavahu kar avagun pachhutaahee jeeau ||

en.bdb: Renounce corruption, and seek virtue; committing sins, you shall only come to regret and repent.

verse.unicode: ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੀਚ ਬੁਡਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: sar apasar kee saar na jaaneh fir fir keech buddaahee jeeau ||2||

en.bdb: You do not know the difference between good and evil; again and again, you sink into the mud. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲੋਭ ਬਹੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: a(n)tar mail lobh bahu jhooThe baahar naavahu kaahee jeeau ||

en.bdb: Within you is the great filth of greed and falsehood; why do you bother to wash your body on the outside?

verse.unicode: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: niramal naam japahu sadh gurmukh a(n)tar kee gat taahee jeeau ||3||

en.bdb: Chant the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord always, under Guru's Instruction; only then will your innermost being be emancipated. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥

transliteration.english: parahar lobh ni(n)dhaa kooR tiaagahu sach gur bachanee fal paahee jeeau ||

en.bdb: Let greed and slander be far away from you, and renounce falsehood; through the True Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall obtain the true fruit.

verse.unicode: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੯॥

transliteration.english: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu har jeeau jan naanak sabadh salaahee jeeau ||4||9||

en.bdb: As it pleases You, You preserve me, Dear Lord; servant Nanak sings the Praises of Your Shabad. ||4||9||
